Name: Seasonal Fantasy Lamp-posts
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]The vanilla lamp-posts are too small so I decided to make taller ones.

This mod adds four new lamp-posts and one lantern!

They have seasonal day and night textures and use sconce light type (with the exception of the spirit lamps and firefly lantern that use colored and lantern lights).
[/size]
[size=3]You can buy them from Robin and Krobus.
